subject: ACME Mobility — invoice provenance & AP handoff: portal / SFTP / VAT evidence
messages:
From: Sophie Jackson <sophie.jackson@acme-mobility.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice delivery & AP contact

Hi Vivek / Kimberly,

We're getting ready to accept your first monthly invoice and I wanted to confirm a couple of things so our AP team can process payments without delays:

- Preferred delivery: We can consume e-invoices via your portal webhook, SFTP drop, or a PDF emailed to ap@acme-mobility.com. Can you confirm which you plan to send?
- VAT evidence: For EU VAT reconciliation we need either a VAT-tagged XML (UBL/PEPPOL) or a copy of the signed invoice plus a validator report. Is that available from your billing system?
- Billing contact: Who should be listed as the billing contact on the invoice (name / email / remit address)? We need a named person for PO matching.

Happy to take sample files so we can run a quick intake test.

Thanks,
Sophie Jackson
AP Operations — ACME Mobility

--
Sophie Jackson
AP Team | acme-mobility.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Jackson <sophie.jackson@acme-mobility.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & AP contact

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, details below:

1) Delivery: We can do portal webhook (recommended), SFTP drop (nightly batch), or email (PDF) as a fallback.
2) VAT evidence: We can emit a VAT-tagged XML (UBL) and include a PDF. For automated reconciliation we'll push the UBL if you can accept it.
3) Billing contact: Proposed contact is Kimberly Park (billing@redwood.com). She'll be the invoice originator and primary for PO match.

I've attached a sample PDF and an example UBL snippet to show the fields we populate. If ACME needs a specific reference (PO number location, remit string), tell us the exact field mapping and we'll tweak the payload.

Suggested next step: Kimberly and I can run a one-hour intake with your AP team (SFTP/portal handshake + sample push). If that works, Marissa (cc'd in follow-ups) will confirm finance acceptance criteria.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample_invoice_redwood_202804.pdf, acme_ap_einvoice_spec_v1.xml
From: Sophie Jackson <sophie.jackson@acme-mobility.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-04T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & AP contact

Thanks, Vivek — that all sounds good. A few clarifications from AP after a quick review:

- Portal webhook is preferred for line-level matching; we can accept SFTP for the first two billing cycles while portal access is provisioned.
- VAT: we require the UBL file with VAT tags (line-level VAT rate + invoice-level VAT total). A PDF alone will not be enough for automated reconciliation.
- PO matching: Our system expects the PO number in the invoice header (field: OrderReference/ID in UBL) and a billing contact with email for exception routing.

Billing contact details (please use these exactly):
Name: Kimberly Park
Email: billing@redwood.com
Remit address: Redwood Inference, 1201 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103

Can Kimberly or Marissa confirm the portal webhook auth method (shared secret or client cert) so our infra can whitelist the endpoint? We'd like to schedule the intake call on Friday 5/6 at 10:00 PT if that works for Redwood.

Regards,
Sophie Jackson
AP Operations — ACME Mobility
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Jackson <sophie.jackson@acme-mobility.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-06T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & AP contact

Hi Sophie — appreciate the clear requirements. Confirming Redwood's plan and next actions: 

- Delivery: We'll do a temporary SFTP nightly push for the first two cycles and enable portal webhook for production. We will send the first SFTP drop on 2028-05-15 (invoice period April 1–30).
- VAT: We'll include a UBL (UBL 2.1) with line-level VAT tags and attach the PDF for human-readable copy. The UBL will place PO in OrderReference/ID as requested.
- Auth: Portal webhook will use a HMAC shared-secret header (x-redwood-signature). For SFTP we will provide a one-time SSH key and a checksum file (.md5) for each batch.
- Billing contact: confirmed (Kimberly Park, billing@redwood.com). She will be available on the intake call for exception-routing questions.

Action items and links:
1) Intake call — confirmed for 2028-05-06 10:00 PT (we'll use Zoom). Meeting invite sent separately.
2) Test artifacts uploaded: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB_example_invoice_samples (contains sample UBL + test PDF).
3) SFTP credentials and a one-time SSH key will be shared via our secure portal to the address you provided.

If ACME needs any field-level mapping beyond PO and VAT (e.g., project codes, tax region tags), please send a sample of your AP parser and we'll map fields on our side before the push.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Finance Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: acme_ap_einvoice_spec_v1.xml
